sorular.soru: What is the element that forms the spiritual essence of Qurbani?
secenekler: A) The meat and hide of the slaughtered animal
B) The distribution of the Qurbani meat
C) An intention made with submission
D) The size of the animal
sorular.aciklama: Qurbani is not merely an act of slaughter; it is an act of worship performed with submission. An animal slaughtered without the intention of worship does not count as Qurbani.

sorular.soru: Why can Qurbani not be regarded merely as meat or material aid?
secenekler: A) Because a slaughter without the intention of worship does not give Qurbani its meaning
B) Because eating its meat is not permissible
C) Because it is a practice intended only for the wealthy
D) Because the choice of animal is specified
sorular.aciklama: Qurbani is an act of worship that gains its meaning through an intention made with submission, not through the act of slaughter itself.

sorular.soru: What is the central message of the story of Prophet Ibrahim preparing to sacrifice his son?
secenekler: A) Slaughter technique and choice of animal
B) The importance of sharing with neighbors
C) The end of a long journey
D) Complete submission to Allah
sorular.aciklama: The story of Prophet Ibrahim symbolizes complete submission to Allah, while the story of Prophet Ismail symbolizes conscious devotion to Allah.

sorular.soru: What does Prophet Ismail's attitude in the story of the sacrifice express?
secenekler: A) Submitting out of helplessness
B) Choosing conscious devotion and submission
C) Obeying out of fear
D) Showing respect to his father
sorular.aciklama: The story of Prophet Ismail symbolizes conscious devotion to Allah and his choice to submit.

sorular.soru: What is the main message taught by the statement, "Neither their meat nor their blood reaches Allah"?
secenekler: A) It is not obligatory to offer Qurbani
B) A large animal must be sacrificed
C) The essence of Qurbani is not meat, but heartfelt taqwa and intention
D) Shedding blood has been forbidden
sorular.aciklama: The essence of Qurbani is taqwa and intention; it is the submission in the heart, not the meat or blood, that reaches Allah.

sorular.soru: According to the Hanafi school, what is the ruling on Qurbani?
secenekler: A) Fard
B) Wajib
C) Emphasized Sunnah
D) Recommended
sorular.aciklama: According to the Hanafi school, Qurbani is wajib; the other schools regard it as an emphasized Sunnah.

sorular.soru: What is the view of the non-Hanafi schools on Qurbani?
secenekler: A) Fard
B) Wajib
C) Voluntary
D) Emphasized Sunnah
sorular.aciklama: The non-Hanafi schools regard Qurbani as an emphasized Sunnah rather than wajib.

sorular.soru: Which of the following is not a condition for being obligated to offer Qurbani?
secenekler: A) Having received higher education
B) Being of sound mind
C) Having reached puberty
D) Being a resident
sorular.aciklama: The conditions for the obligation of Qurbani are being of sound mind, having reached puberty, being a resident, and having sufficient financial means. Education is not a condition.

sorular.soru: What does 'being a resident' mean with regard to the obligation of Qurbani?
secenekler: A) Living in a large city
B) Owning a home
C) Not being a traveler
D) Being registered as part of the local population
sorular.aciklama: Being a resident means residing in a place rather than being classified as a traveler; travelers are exempt from the obligation of Qurbani.

sorular.soru: When should the Qurbani animal be slaughtered?
secenekler: A) At any time on the night before Eid
B) After the Eid prayer, during the three days of Eid
C) Early in the morning before the Eid prayer
D) Only at noon on the first day
sorular.aciklama: The Qurbani animal is slaughtered after the Eid prayer. Slaughtering it before the Eid prayer is invalid, and the sacrifice must be repeated.

sorular.soru: What is the ruling for someone who slaughters a Qurbani animal before the Eid prayer?
secenekler: A) Their Qurbani has been accepted
B) Only a Sunnah has been missed
C) Paying expiation is sufficient
D) The Qurbani is invalid and must be repeated
sorular.aciklama: A slaughter performed before the Eid prayer does not count as Qurbani; the wajib obligation remains unfulfilled.

sorular.soru: Which animals may be slaughtered for Qurbani?
secenekler: A) Sheep, goats, cattle, water buffalo, and camels
B) Only sheep and goats
C) All kinds of domestic animals
D) Sheep, goats, and chickens
sorular.aciklama: Animals that may be slaughtered for Qurbani are sheep, goats, cattle, water buffalo, and camels.

sorular.soru: How many people may share a large animal for Qurbani?
secenekler: A) 3 people
B) 5 people
C) 7 people
D) 10 people
sorular.aciklama: A maximum of 7 people may share a large animal such as cattle, water buffalo, or camels.

sorular.soru: How many people may share a sheep or goat for Qurbani?
secenekler: A) 7 people
B) 1 person
C) 3 people
D) 2 people
sorular.aciklama: A sheep or goat for Qurbani is slaughtered on behalf of only 1 person; sharing it is invalid.

sorular.soru: What is the age requirement for a sheep offered as Qurbani?
secenekler: A) At least 6 months old
B) At least 2 years old
C) There is no age requirement
D) At least 1 year old, or a well-developed 6-month-old ram
sorular.aciklama: A sheep must be at least 1 year old; however, a very well-developed ram may be slaughtered even if it is 6 months old.

sorular.soru: A farmer wants to offer a healthy 18-month-old bovine as Qurbani. Is this Qurbani valid?
secenekler: A) No; cattle and water buffalo must be at least 2 years old
B) Yes; any bovine over 1 year old may be slaughtered
C) Yes; being healthy is sufficient, and there is no age requirement
D) No; only cattle over 3 years old may be slaughtered
sorular.aciklama: Cattle and water buffalo offered as Qurbani must be at least 2 years old; an 18-month-old bovine does not meet this requirement.

sorular.soru: What is the minimum age for a camel offered as Qurbani?
secenekler: A) 2 years old
B) 5 years old
C) 3 years old
D) 4 years old
sorular.aciklama: A camel offered as Qurbani must be at least 5 years old.

sorular.soru: If Qurbani meat is divided into three portions, to whom are the portions given?
secenekler: A) All of it is distributed to the poor
B) All of it belongs to the household
C) One portion to the household, one to neighbors and relatives, and one to the poor
D) Two portions to the poor and one to the person offering the Qurbani
sorular.aciklama: It is recommended to divide Qurbani meat into three portions: one for the household, one for neighbors and relatives, and one for the poor.

sorular.soru: Which of the following defects makes an animal invalid for Qurbani?
secenekler: A) The animal is dark in color
B) The animal is male
C) The animal has eaten mainly feed
D) The animal is blind in one eye
sorular.aciklama: Animals that are blind, sick, severely lame, or extremely emaciated are invalid for Qurbani.

sorular.soru: Can an animal that is slightly lame be offered as Qurbani?
secenekler: A) Yes, slight lameness is not considered a defect
B) No, under no circumstances
C) This applies only to large animals
D) Only in cases of necessity
sorular.aciklama: Severe lameness that prevents an animal from walking is considered a defect; slight lameness does not invalidate the Qurbani.

sorular.soru: Why is it important to sharpen the knife well?
secenekler: A) To make the slaughter appear quick
B) To improve the quality of the meat
C) To prevent the animal from suffering
D) Because it is a traditional habit
sorular.aciklama: Showing mercy to the living beings Allah created is a fundamental principle of Islam. Sharpening the knife well reduces the animal's suffering.

sorular.soru: Why is sharpening the knife in front of the animal forbidden when performing Qurbani?
secenekler: A) Because hygiene rules require it
B) To avoid frightening or tormenting the animal
C) To prevent the knife from rusting
D) Because it is a traditional practice
sorular.aciklama: The Messenger of Allah instructed that the knife be sharpened out of the animal's sight; this reflects Islam's principle of mercy.

sorular.soru: Why is it obligatory to mention Allah's name when slaughtering for Qurbani?
secenekler: A) For the slaughter to be halal
B) To keep one's voice loud
C) To calm the animal
D) To announce it to those nearby
sorular.aciklama: The meat of an animal slaughtered without mentioning Allah's name is not considered halal. Saying Bismillah is an integral part of the religious aspect of Qurbani.

sorular.soru: What is the ruling on a person eating the meat of their own Qurbani?
secenekler: A) It is forbidden; all of it must be distributed
B) It should not be eaten because it is slaughtered only for the poor
C) It is obligatory, though not fard
D) It is recommended; eating its meat is in keeping with the Sunnah
sorular.aciklama: It is recommended for a person to eat from their own Qurbani, while offering it to others is part of the social aspect of this act of worship.

sorular.soru: How is Qurbani meat traditionally recommended to be divided?
secenekler: A) All of it is given to the poor
B) All of it is consumed by the family
C) One portion for oneself, one for neighbors, and one for those in need
D) It is distributed only to relatives
sorular.aciklama: The traditional practice is to keep one portion for oneself, give one portion to neighbors and friends, and give one portion to those in need.

sorular.soru: What is the social aspect of Qurbani?
secenekler: A) It shows that it is solely an individual act of worship
B) It includes sharing, solidarity, and reaching those in need
C) It is performed to regulate meat prices
D) It is an occasion to hold gatherings
sorular.aciklama: Qurbani includes a culture of sharing, social solidarity, and reaching those in need.

sorular.soru: Does donating money before slaughtering an animal take the place of Qurbani?
secenekler: A) No, Qurbani is a distinct act of worship and cannot be replaced by charity
B) Yes, it carries the same reward as Qurbani
C) It applies only to the poor
D) They are the same because the meaning is what matters
sorular.aciklama: Donating the cost of a Qurbani is a good deed; however, it does not discharge the obligation of someone for whom Qurbani is wajib.

sorular.soru: What is the ruling on selling the hide of a Qurbani animal and keeping the money?
secenekler: A) It is entirely permissible
B) The person offering the Qurbani may make use of the hide
C) Special permission is required only to sell the hide
D) Selling the hide is not permissible; it should be given to a charity
sorular.aciklama: The person offering the Qurbani cannot sell its hide and keep the money; it should be donated for charitable purposes.

sorular.soru: Which of the following is a common mistake made when offering Qurbani?
secenekler: A) Sharing a large animal among seven people
B) Checking the animal's age
C) Slaughtering it before the Eid prayer
D) Slaughtering it while saying Bismillah
sorular.aciklama: Slaughtering the animal before the Eid prayer is one of the most common mistakes that invalidates Qurbani.

sorular.soru: Why is Islam's principle of mercy important in the slaughter of Qurbani animals?
secenekler: A) To shorten the slaughtering time
B) To reduce the animal's suffering and show respect for the living creatures Allah has created
C) It comes from habit
D) To improve meat quality
sorular.aciklama: Mercy toward the living creatures Allah has created is one of the fundamental principles of Islam; sharpening the knife out of the animal's sight puts this understanding into practice.

sorular.soru: What lesson from the story of Prophet Ibrahim is one expected to apply in personal life?
secenekler: A) Slaughter a larger animal every year
B) Teach children everything
C) Give more charity
D) Be willing to give up attachments for Allah
sorular.aciklama: Qurbani tests where we place ourselves in relation to Allah; the lesson from the story is to be able to give up attachments for Allah.

sorular.soru: How many days does the time for slaughtering a Qurbani animal last?
secenekler: A) 3 days
B) 1 day
C) 2 days
D) 4 days
sorular.aciklama: The time for slaughtering a Qurbani animal begins after the Eid prayer and lasts 3 days.

sorular.soru: Why must the shares in a large animal be equal?
secenekler: A) To divide the meat equally
B) To be exempt from tax
C) The shares must be equal for the intention to be considered valid
D) To determine the animal's value
sorular.aciklama: When sharing a large animal, the shares must be equal, and each person must have a separate intention; unequal shares may invalidate the Qurbani.

sorular.soru: When should the intention be made for slaughtering a Qurbani animal?
secenekler: A) A few days before buying the animal
B) In the heart at the time of slaughter or beforehand
C) During the Eid sermon
D) Making an intention is not required
sorular.aciklama: Qurbani is an act of worship that requires an intention; at the time of slaughter or beforehand, one must intend in the heart that it is being done to seek Allah's pleasure.

sorular.soru: How is financial sufficiency defined for the obligation of Qurbani?
secenekler: A) Being wealthy
B) Having a steady income
C) Owning property
D) Having enough wealth beyond basic needs to purchase a Qurbani animal
sorular.aciklama: A person who has enough wealth to purchase a Qurbani animal after meeting their basic needs satisfies the condition of financial sufficiency.
